summary: The device detected a near miss at t0 with a closing object at 4.2 m/s and 0.8 s to contact, but no physical contact occurred. The video shows a test pattern with no real-world environment, so no actual hazard or impact was observed. The event was correctly classified as a near miss by the device.

sequence_of_events.description: Rear sensor R2 detected an approaching object with a closing rate of 4.2 m/s, time to contact of 0.8 s, and range of 3.40 m. A warning pulse was triggered on the back motor.
Near miss confirmed on sensor R2: object closing at 4.2 m/s, 0.8 s to contact, 3.40 m away, with no impact detected.
Range sensor R2 recorded a closest echo at 0.10 m, indicating the object passed within 0.10 m of the hat.
Video shows a test pattern with no real-world environment.
Video shows a test pattern with a gray square in the lower-left and a rainbow gradient line.
Video shows a gray square in the lower-left and rainbow gradient line.
Video shows the gray square and rainbow gradient line still present.

evidence.environment: Near-wearer conditions (indicative): CO2 612 ppm, temperature 21.4 C, relative humidity 38%.

hazard.energy_source: kinetic energy from an object closing at 4.2 m/s

risk.severity_justification: Potential for minor injury (e.g., bruising or minor laceration) if impact occurred.
risk.likelihood_justification: High likelihood due to object closing at 4.2 m/s and passing within 0.10 m of the hat, but no impact occurred.

immediate.description: The object was not controlled or removed from the worker’s path before reaching 0.10 m.
The environment was not monitored for approaching objects, and no visual or auditory warning was provided to the worker.

root_five_whys: Why was the object not controlled? Because no one was monitoring the area for approaching objects.
Why was no one monitoring the area? Because the worker was not provided with a visual or auditory warning system.
Why was no warning system provided? Because the site did not implement a system to detect and warn of approaching objects.
Why was no such system implemented? Because the site did not assess the risk of falling objects in the area.
Why was no risk assessment conducted? Because the site did not have a formal hazard identification and risk assessment process.

corrective_actions.description: Implement a real-time object detection and warning system for all workers in high-risk areas.
Conduct a site-wide hazard identification and risk assessment to identify all potential falling object hazards.
Provide all workers with training on how to respond to near-miss events and how to avoid falling object hazards.
Install physical barriers or protective equipment in areas where falling objects are a risk.
